Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Duration 1 minute

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or fall fully under your sway for the duration: it treats you as its only ally, defends you if attacked, and cannot willingly harm you by any means (on a critical failure, it also obeys one non-suicidal command you give as part of casting this). This is an emotion, incapacitation, and mental effect. This is not friendship, and it never was.
